application: scripts/depthn_screen_amended_verdict.py --run-binding <the screen-r2 adoption record> <its sha256> --run-amendment <this file> <its sha256>: the screen-r2 binding requires this record (pinned in RUN_AMENDMENTS), and the final-fairness gate then runs as scripts/depthn_fairness_final.py final_gate(..., bands='exact'). The drift diagnosis is scripts/depthn_fairness_final.py window --alive-bands exact. The four adopted rule files, their logic and their sha256s are unchanged.
computed_before: No outcome statistic of screen-r2 has been computed or inspected: no score, win, paired difference, interval or bound, of either arm. This amendment is derived from fairness data only (Foul Play iteration rates, their budget strata, turns and alive counts): flag-1 (100 pairs, ratio, weighted 0.937, acknowledged benign), flag-2 (150 pairs, drift, window 216, weighted 1.112), the flag-1 diagnosis (finer 1.045, within), the flag-2 window diagnosis (finer 1.088, not within) and the whole-run diagnosis at 150 pairs (finer 1.0515, not within; final_gate on the same data: difference 0.05155), cited by sha256 in evidence. In the finer re-stratification the matched strata read 0.98-1.01; every large deviation sits in the coarse 1-2 alive endgame buckets, which pool one and two alive Pokemon. The panel was stopped at flag-2; the result files were counted by name only (panel_state), never read for this record.
decided_by: the lead (search, V2, CUDA): one outcome-blind amendment, then resume

evidence.what: flag 1 acknowledged benign by the lead
flag 2: 150 pairs, reason drift, window 216, weighted 1.112
flag-1 diagnosis, coarse alive buckets: finer 1.045, within
flag-2 window diagnosis (window 216), coarse alive buckets: finer 1.088, not within
whole run at 150 pairs, coarse alive buckets: finer 1.0515, not within; final_gate on the same data: difference 0.05155

evidence_note: the three diagnoses come from screen-r1's pre-registered fairness_diag.py (the lead's script, a pod-local copy, run unchanged); /out is the cluster's /out mount, as in the declaration

panel_state.condition: the panel stopped and no worker running
panel_state.method: in /out/screen-r2: completions_jsonl_sha256 = sha256 of state/completions.jsonl; fairness_screen_sha256 = sha256 of the files of state/fairness/screen/ concatenated in name order (ack-1.json, checks.jsonl, flag-1.json, flag-2.json); result_names_sha256 = sha256 of the newline-joined sorted names of results/ (`ls | sort`; names only, never contents); combined_sha256 = sha256 of '<completions> <fairness> <names>' (the three hex digests, space-separated) with a trailing newline

replaces: for screen-r2 only: the final-fairness gate's and the drift diagnosis's alive buckets 1-2 / 3-4 / 5-6 per side (the final-fairness amendment, b2fccc25)
